test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Yug covers a certain distance with a speed of 56 km/h in (3)/(2) hours. If he wants to cover the same distance in 7 hours, what would be his speed (in km/h)?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed = 56 km/h, Time = (3)/(2) hours.

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Speed = Distance / Time

**Calculation:**

Distance covered in (3)/(2) hours = 56 × (3)/(2)

Distance = (56 × 3)/(2) = (168)/(2) = 84 km

To cover the same distance in 7 hours, speed = (Distance)/(Time) = (84)/(7)

Speed = 12 km/h

**The speed required to cover the same distance in 7 hours is 12 km/h.**
